package.name: GPT4FreeCAD
package.description: Generate parametric FreeCAD geometry from natural-language descriptions. Supports Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and local GGUF models run on your own machine (no API key, offline) via the Machine Activation SDK. Produces validated, structured CAD operations (boxes, cylinders, booleans, fillets, extrudes, revolves, and more) built as an editable feature tree, with an optional advanced Python-scripting mode.

workbench.name: GPT4FreeCAD
workbench.description: Generate CAD geometry from natural language using LLMs.
